name: bb-plugin-voice-concierge
description: bb plugin: talk to bb hands-free. A realtime voice concierge that sees your threads and answers aloud, in its own conversation, never in your work threads.

bb.name: Voice Concierge
bb.description: Talk to bb out loud: ask what is running, what needs you, what a thread concluded. A realtime voice agent (Codex, on your ChatGPT plan) answers aloud; its conversation stays in its own thread, and it writes to other threads only when you ask and confirm.
